APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Acet. ac.]
Intense thirst. θ Diabetes. θ Dropsy. θ Chronic diarrhœa.
Thirsty with dry lips, which peel off in flakes. θ Inflammation of bowels in dentition.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Acet. ac.]
Diarrhœa : with swelling of legs and feet (phthisis) ; in later stages of abdominal typhus ; chronic with thirst (ascites) ; more in morning ; profuse, very weakening (fifteen passages) on seventeenth day (typhus).
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Acet. ac.]
Metrorrhagia.
   

FEVER. [40] [Acet. ac.]
Profuse sweating ; night-sweats.
Hectic fevers, with cough, dyspnœa, diarrhœa, night-sweats, œdema and emaciation.
Inflammatory fever.
   

SKIN. [46] [Acet. ac.]
Burning dry skin. θ Inflammation of bowels in dentition.
Nevi, warts, corns.
